prisoner.name: Rev. Bill Hogan
prisoner.description: Rev. Bill Hogan was jailed following an anti-nuclear protest at the LaSalle nuclear power plant in Illinois. A contemporary June1983 report records an April20 trespass conviction and a thirty-day contempt sentence after the two defendants spoke about the dangers of nuclear power despite the judge's order. An additional fifteen-day trespass sentence followed. Both were released on appeal bond on May23,1983.
prisoner.body: Source: Nuclear Resister17, June6,1983, page4. The reported thirty- and fifteen-day sentences are not stored as actual time served.
